# sync-me

> A Claude Code skill that runs an interactive, grill-style teaching session for a person working with a coding agent, in four modes: unstick (one confusing point), catch-up (a long session the user missed), walk (a task only the user can execute) and decide (decisions the agent left for the user, asked one at a time with a recommendation and the cost of each option). It maps uncertainty branches and checks recall per branch. An optional Stop hook, off by default, starts decide mode when a reply leaves decisions in prose.

## Core

- [README](README.md): motivation, installation, usage, notes location, method, limitations.
- [SKILL.md](skills/sync-me/SKILL.md): the complete specification.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for a coding agent working on this repo.
